summary: Wes Moore spoke at a 2023 Stand with Israel rally and in 2024 called a student vigil for Gaza at the University of Maryland inappropriate. By May 2026 he said Netanyahu committed war crimes by using food as a negotiating tool in Gaza but stopped short of calling the situation a genocide, affirming both Israel's and Palestinians' right to exist. His condemnation remains directed at Netanyahu specifically rather than at the broader conduct of the Israeli state.
